name: workflow-shell-marketplace
description: Rohit's spec-driven workflow shell (with the SDK memory pipeline merged in) and a drift reconciler, distributed as installable Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: workflow-shell
plugins.description: Routing, a 6-phase state machine, verifier/fixer loops, a categorized agent tree, workflow skills, the Workflow Orchestrator output style, and the SDK memory pipeline + full hook surface. Per-project adoption via /workflow-init.

plugins.name: workflow-refresh
plugins.description: Drift reconciler: detect & repair divergence between an adopted project and the currently installed workflow-shell. Dry-run first, then /workflow-refresh --apply. Idempotent; never clobbers project-owned state. Does not adopt (use /workflow-init).
